verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises large-codebase querying with a 1M-token context window (gemini-cli-gh-1) and one HN commenter praises its ability to 'navigate and learn' huge codebases effortlessly (gemini-cli-comm-1), but multiple other developers report the opposite experience, calling it 'so stupid at navigation in the codebase it takes 10x as long' and noting it 'gets stuck in spaghetti code' with no plan mode (gemini-cli-comm-14, gemini-cli-comm-15), plus frequent agentic failures during exploration (gemini-cli-comm-10, gemini-cli-comm-11).
